_comment: Every clause of this card acted on the wrong object. The -1{d} counter named a target ('equipment') that the compiler did not read, so the debuff aimed at the defender landed on the ATTACKING card. The 'then if it has 0{d}' test was COUNTER_GTE amount 0 against the source -- true for every card at all times -- and DESTROY_REF read neither its 'target' nor any ref, so the destroy fired unconditionally on whatever ref happened to be set. Now: PUT_COUNTER records what it counted under the ref 'countered', and both the test and the destroy read that object. The counter kind is '-1d' rather than DEFENSE+mod:subtract because the sign is part of the kind, and because '-1d' is what the defence recalc subtracts.
